```{=html}
<style>
:root {
  --bg: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, #f6fbff 0%, #eef8f3 40%, #e7f2ff 100%);
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --border: #d7e6ea;
  --ink: #113146;
  --accent: #0b7a75;
}

body {
  background: var(--bg);
}

.dash-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
  align-items: start;
}

.panel {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px;
}

.panel h3 {
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.meta-badge {
  background: #e8f4f3;
  border: 1px solid #cbe3e1;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  margin: 0 6px 6px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  display: inline-block;
}

.matrix-wrap {
  border: 1px solid #d3e3e8;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px;
  background: #fcffff;
  max-height: 620px;
  overflow: auto;
}

.cell-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(33, 16px);
  grid-auto-rows: 16px;
  gap: 3px;
  justify-content: center;
}

.cell-btn {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #c4d7dd;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
}

.cell-btn.active {
  outline: 2px solid #111;
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.matrix-caption {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #405866;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.t-legend {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 6px 10px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.t-legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #2c495b;
}

.t-legend-chip {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  border: 1px solid #89a3af;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.wave-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.wave-table th,
.wave-table td {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e0ebef;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.wave-table th {
  background: #f2f8fa;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.wave-col {
  max-width: 560px;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.num-col {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  .dash-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<div id="runtime-debug" style="display:none; margin: 8px 0 14px 0; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #e0b4b4; background: #fff6f6; border-radius: 8px; color: #6b1f1f; font-size: 12px;">
  <strong>Runtime debug:</strong>
  <pre id="runtime-debug-log" style="margin: 6px 0 0 0; white-space: pre-wrap;"></pre>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const box = document.getElementById("runtime-debug");
  const log = document.getElementById("runtime-debug-log");
  const append = (msg) => {
    if (!box || !log) return;
    box.style.display = "block";
    log.textContent += (log.textContent ? "\n" : "") + msg;
  };
  window.addEventListener("error", (e) => append(`error: ${e.message}`));
  window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e) => append(`promise: ${e.reason}`));
})();
</script>
```

```{ojs}
manifest = await FileAttachment("artifacts/dashboard/manifest.json").json()
cells = await FileAttachment("artifacts/dashboard/cells.json").json()
amplitudes = await FileAttachment("artifacts/dashboard/amplitudes.json").json()

tColors = [
  "#2a9d8f", "#45b39d", "#8ab17d", "#f4a261", "#e76f51", "#c77dff",
  "#6d597a", "#4cc9f0", "#4895ef", "#4361ee", "#3a0ca3"
]

viewof selectedWave = Inputs.select(manifest.waves, {
  label: "Wave (all 14 available)",
  value: manifest.waves[0]
})

function colorForCell(c, minv, maxv) {
  const base = tColors[c.t_index - 1] ?? "#90a4ae"
  const v = Math.log10(c.total_intensity + 1)
  const ratio = (v - minv) / (maxv - minv + 1e-12)
  const alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ratio))
  return `${base}${Math.round(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
}

function matrixInput(cells, selected = {m_index: 1, t_index: 1}) {
  const wrap = html`<div class="matrix-wrap"></div>`
  const grid = html`<div class="cell-grid"></div>`
  wrap.append(grid)

  const sorted = [...cells].sort((a, b) => {
    const aid = (a.m_index - 1) * 100 + a.t_index
    const bid = (b.m_index - 1) * 100 + b.t_index
    return aid - bid
  })

  let current = selected
  Object.defineProperty(wrap, "value", {
    get() { return current },
    set(v) { current = v }
  })

  const vals = sorted.map(d => Math.log10(d.total_intensity + 1))
  const minv = Math.min(...vals)
  const maxv = Math.max(...vals)

  for (const c of sorted) {
    const btn = html`<button class="cell-btn" aria-label="m ${c.m_index}, t ${c.t_index}"></button>`
    btn.title = `m index ${c.m_index}, t index ${c.t_index}, total intensity ${c.total_intensity.toFixed(2)}`
    btn.style.background = colorForCell(c, minv, maxv)

    if (c.m_index === current.m_index && c.t_index === current.t_index) btn.classList.add("active")

    btn.onclick = () => {
      current = {m_index: c.m_index, t_index: c.t_index}
      for (const b of grid.querySelectorAll(".cell-btn")) b.classList.remove("active")
      btn.classList.add("active")
      wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"))
    }

    grid.append(btn)
  }

  wrap.append(html`<div class="matrix-caption">All 1100 cells (100 m(3π) bins × 11 t' bins). Color indicates t' slice; shade indicates total intensity.</div>`)

  const legend = html`<div class="t-legend"></div>`
  manifest.tprime_bins.forEach((tb, idx) => {
    legend.append(html`<div class="t-legend-item"><span class="t-legend-chip" style="background:${tColors[idx]}"></span><span>t' ${idx + 1}: ${tb.low.toFixed(3)} - ${tb.high.toFixed(3)}</span></div>`)
  })
  wrap.append(legend)

  return wrap
}

viewof selectedCell = matrixInput(cells)
selectedCellSummary = cells.find(d => d.m_index === selectedCell.m_index && d.t_index === selectedCell.t_index)

activeT = selectedCell.t_index
activeM = selectedCell.m_index

waveSeries = amplitudes
  .filter(d => d.wave === selectedWave && d.t_index === activeT)
  .sort((a, b) => a.m_center - b.m_center)
  .map(d => ({
    ...d,
    i_lo: Math.max(0, d.intensity - (d.sigma_intensity ?? 0)),
    i_hi: d.intensity + (d.sigma_intensity ?? 0),
    is_selected_m: d.m_index === activeM
  }))

selectedWavePoint = waveSeries.find(d => d.m_index === activeM)

cellTrajectory = waveSeries

cellWaveRows = amplitudes
  .filter(d => d.m_index === activeM && d.t_index === activeT)
  .sort((a, b) => b.intensity - a.intensity)

topWaves = cellWaveRows.map((d, i) => ({
  rank: i + 1,
  wave: d.wave,
  intensity: d.intensity,
  sigma_intensity: d.sigma_intensity ?? 0,
  phase: d.phase,
  re: d.re,
  im: d.im
}))
```

## Wave Intensity vs m(3π) (active t' from clicked cell)

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 70,
  marginBottom: 52,
  width: 1100,
  height: 430,
  x: {label: "m(3π) [GeV/c²]", grid: true},
  y: {label: "|A|² (intensity)", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.link(waveSeries, {x1: "m_center", y1: "i_lo", x2: "m_center", y2: "i_hi", stroke: "#84c9c3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
    Plot.line(waveSeries, {x: "m_center", y: "intensity", stroke: "#0b7a75", strokeWidth: 2.4}),
    Plot.dot(waveSeries, {x: "m_center", y: "intensity", r: 2.5, fill: "#0b7a75"}),
    Plot.dot(waveSeries.filter(d => d.is_selected_m), {x: "m_center", y: "intensity", r: 6, fill: "#d62828", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 1.5})
  ]
})
```

## RE/IM Trajectory for Selected Wave (active t')

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 70,
  marginBottom: 52,
  width: 1100,
  height: 430,
  x: {label: "RE(A)", grid: true},
  y: {label: "IM(A)", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(cellTrajectory, {x: "re", y: "im", stroke: "#1f4e79", strokeWidth: 2.2}),
    Plot.dot(cellTrajectory, {x: "re", y: "im", r: 2.5, fill: "#1f4e79"}),
    Plot.dot(cellTrajectory.filter(d => d.is_selected_m), {x: "re", y: "im", r: 6, fill: "#d62828", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 1.5})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
      <td class="wave-col">${r.wave}</td>
      <td class="num-col">${r.intensity.toFixed(3)}</td>
```
